steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to Grafana at http://127.0.0.1:3000/ using username admin and password exactly {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}. Verify that the signed-in Grafana page is reached.
02-find: Find and open the provisioned dashboard named Service health, then report the titles of all its panels exactly as displayed on the dashboard.

03-create: Create a NEW Grafana dashboard titled {{runid}} Bench Dashboard. Add a Stat panel titled {{runid}} Availability whose query uses the TestData data source, then apply the panel and explicitly save the dashboard. Verify the saved dashboard title, panel title/type, selected query data source, and report the dashboard page URL read from the browser.

04-add: On the existing saved dashboard {{runid}} Bench Dashboard, add a Text visualization panel titled {{runid}} Notes with content that includes the exact runid {{runid}}. Apply it and explicitly save the dashboard. Verify the saved panel title and that its rendered content includes the runid.

05-set: Update the saved dashboard {{runid}} Bench Dashboard to have the tag bench and a default time range of last 6 hours. Ensure the time picker is set to Last 6 hours, then explicitly save and tick the save dialog's 'Update default time range' option so the range persists. Verify the tag and persistence choice from the saved dashboard/save confirmation.
06-set: Set the saved dashboard {{runid}} Bench Dashboard auto-refresh interval to 1m and explicitly save the dashboard. Verify the auto-refresh control shows 1m after saving.

07-report: On the saved dashboard {{runid}} Bench Dashboard, read the current browser page URL directly from the address bar after loading the dashboard, and report its exact URL or UID. Also confirm the saved title and the visible 1m auto-refresh state.
